notes.title: Development Branch Update - v1.000
notes.notes:
Hello Astronauts! 

We've just released a new update (v1.000) on the development branch! 🚀

This version is a sneak peek of the next big update, focusing on enhancing gameplay and exploration.

Please share any performance feedback or bug reports—you help us improve!

As always, restart your launcher to apply the update and back up your save files before testing the development branch. For co-op, ensure all players are using the same version. If you encounter issues, disable mods before reporting bugs.

Temporary Changelog
New Lunar Roving Vehicle Feature!

Added a fully interactive vehicle with customizable modules for exploration and travel.
vehicle components are available to craft from advanced workstations.

The Lunar Roving Vehicle has been meticulously modeled and simulated to match the real-life counterpart with precision. Additionally, you’ll be able to customize it with your choice of weapon modifications, making it uniquely yours!

The U.S. Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle from
Apollo 15 on the Moon in 1971

Improved Terrain Generation

Enhanced planetary features to better integrate with the new vehicle.
New resource nodes and hidden areas accessible via your spacecraft.

Performance Enhancements

Optimized rendering for improved frame rates during large-scale space travel.
Addressed memory leaks when switching between planetary zones.

Bug Fixes and Balances

Fixed an issue causing crash errors during vehicle docking sequences.
Adjusted collision detection for spaceship components.
Improved UI responsiveness in crafting menus.
